100% Tencel (OEKO-Tex Certified)

Tencel is breathable, durable and incredibly soft to the touch.

The TENCEL™ brand manufacturing process is powered by 100% renewable energy and uses significantly less water!

Hand wash with like colors. Do not tumble dry. Hang to dry. 
Iron at low temperature if needed. Do not use bleach.
Can be dry cleaned.

title: Par Ici Alien Head Pendant Necklace - Gold or Silver (In-Store)
description:
What better way to welcome our alien overlords than with Par Ici's Alien Head Pendant? It's totally out of this world! Featuring iconic extraterrestrial imagery in a 22K gold plate or solid silver, this necklace is sure to captivate all who look upon it.

Gold Chain: 16"

Silver Chain: 20"

General Care

Remove jewelry when bathing, exercising, sleeping, or cleaning. Always avoid excess moisture, and remember to store your pieces properly (preferably in an airtight container, not next to the sink or bathtub - we struggle with that too!) when you aren't wearing them. It is normal for metal to oxidize (or change colour) with time and exposure to the elements, but contact with liquid or other substances can expedite this process.

Sterling Silver

Gently polish with a jewelry polishing cloth to bring sterling silver pieces back to their original state of lustre.

Gold Vermeil, Rhodium, and 22K Gold Plated

Gently clean with mild dish soap and a soft brush but please do not polish! Gold vermeil is a thick gold plating that can actually be removed with polishing. Once completely dry, store your pieces in an airtight container, such as a ziplock bag, to avoid oxidization.

Handmade in Toronto 

When you shop with Victoire, you're supporting independent Canadian designers from across the country. Designers Eve and Alynne bonded over a shared obsession with vintage jewellery at parties and in elevators at their university co-op building. They started out collecting and selling vintage jewellery in Toronto, New York and LA, and eventually pieces from their collection found their way to the pages of international Vogues, W Magazine and Elle, among others. Very naturally, the amassed vintage helped inspire the first collection Eve and Alynne designed together. They create captivating jewelry that walks the line between simplicity and boldness, balancing contemporary design with hints of the past throughout their collection.

title: Ash & Posy Succulent Sage Hydrating Serum
description:
Get a boost of hydration with Ash & Posy's Succulent Sage Hydrating Serum.  An aloe based serum with dual weight hyaluronic acid, aloe, sage extract and radish root ferment.  Meticulously formulated with high and low molecular weight hyaluronic acid aiding skin barrier function while drawing and maintaining moisture.  Sage extract will sooth hot inflamed skin and is an effective natural antioxidant.

Aloe Barbadensis (Aloe) Leaf Juice*, Sodium Hyaluronate (Hyaluronic Acid), Leuconostoc Root (Radish Root) Ferment Filtrate, Lactobacillus, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Fruit Extract, Xanthan Gum, Lecithin, Sclerotium Gum, Pullulan, Salvia Sclarea (Clary Sage), Salvia Apiana (White Sage) Leaf, santalum album + Mitti attar (mitti attar)*.

description:
The Amandine bag from Market Canvas is a luxurious leather travel bag with a timelessly chic appeal! Leather Care:

For optimal care and maintenance of your bag, it's recommended to treat it with leather conditioner once a year. Not only does this hydrate the leather, but it also adds an extra layer of protection.

Daily wear may result in small scratches on your bag, which are simply a natural part of owning a leather accessory. Fortunately, many of these marks can be buffed out using a lightly damp cloth in a circular motion. Applying a bit of leather conditioner afterwards can help rejuvenate your bag.

In case of any spots or stains, a 1:1 mixture of saddle or Castile soap and warm water, along with a soft cloth, should do the trick for spot cleaning.

For more stubborn marks like ink stains, a cotton swab dipped in rubbing alcohol can be used, followed by a touch-up with leather conditioner for added protection and shine.

Handmade in Tofino, BC

title: Market Canvas Leather Croissant Keychain
description:
Locally sourced premium top grain leather and natural brass hardware.

Leather Care:

For optimal care and maintenance of your bag, it's recommended to treat it with leather conditioner once a year. Not only does this hydrate the leather, but it also adds an extra layer of protection.

Daily wear may result in small scratches on your bag, which are simply a natural part of owning a leather accessory. Fortunately, many of these marks can be buffed out using a lightly damp cloth in a circular motion. Applying a bit of leather conditioner afterwards can help rejuvenate your bag.

In case of any spots or stains, a 1:1 mixture of saddle or Castile soap and warm water, along with a soft cloth, should do the trick for spot cleaning.

For more stubborn marks like ink stains, a cotton swab dipped in rubbing alcohol can be used, followed by a touch-up with leather conditioner for added protection and shine.

Handmade in Tofino, BC

title: ORA-C Nodes Choker Necklace (Brass)
description:

Brass and Silver Care:

Rub your brass and silver jewelry with a polishing regularly (ideally after each wear) to restore the shine of your brass and silver. Always store your pieces in a dry place, preferably in a jewelry box or the box it came with. Avoid the bathroom and any humid or sunny area to store your jewelry.

In the event where your brass has tarnished to a dark tone and you wish to restore it to it’s original color, regular white vinegar or a mix of lemon juice and baking soda are great non-toxic ways to clean your pieces. To do that, either dip your piece fully in said solution for a maximum of 5min, (when you have no stones) or use a soft tooth brush and apply your vinegar or lemon/baking soda mix on the metal areas only (ideally avoid pearls and all stones). You will see the metal lightening and regain it's original tone. Then rinse thoroughly with cold water and pat completely dry with a towel or even a fan. Once fully dried, proceed to rub your piece with a polishing cloth to give it back it's shine.

Hand crafted in Montreal, QC.

When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent Canadian designers like Caroline Pham the creator and designer of ORA-C Jewelry. Carline meticulously fabricates every piece by hand in her Montreal studio as unique wearable sculptural works. Her pieces are delicate yet bold, featuring striking color compositions and textured metal work. While Caroline finds beauty in the imperfections of the handmade object, her work is grounded in the value of good craftsmanship. She takes inspiration from ancient techniques and artifacts of the past, but her self-taught and experimental approach to jewelry-making paired with her eye for expressive styling gives an edge to her work.

To do that, either dip your piece fully in said solution for a maximum of 5min, (when you have no stones) or use a soft tooth brush and apply your vinegar or lemon/baking soda mix on the metal areas only (ideally avoid pearls and all stones). You will see the metal lightening and regain it's original tone. Then rinse thoroughly with cold water and pat completely dry with a towel or even a fan. Once fully dried, proceed to rub your piece with a polishing cloth to give it back it's shine.

Hand crafted in Montreal, QC.

title: Market Canvas Rapha Satchel (Toffee)
description:
Crafted from premium top-grain leather, the Rapha Satchel brings Graceful, structured, and effortlessly refined. Its sculptural shape and rich tones evoke quiet luxury, while the locking clasp adds a touch of modern sophistication. Designed to turn heads without trying too hard

Dimensions: 12" W x 10" H x 10"D

100% locally sourced premium top grain leather with natural brass hardware.

Leather Care:

For optimal care and maintenance of your bag, it's recommended to treat it with leather conditioner once a year. Not only does this hydrate the leather, but it also adds an extra layer of protection.

Daily wear may result in small scratches on your bag, which are simply a natural part of owning a leather accessory. Fortunately, many of these marks can be buffed out using a lightly damp cloth in a circular motion. Applying a bit of leather conditioner afterwards can help rejuvenate your bag.

In case of any spots or stains, a 1:1 mixture of saddle or Castile soap and warm water, along with a soft cloth, should do the trick for spot cleaning.

For more stubborn marks like ink stains, a cotton swab dipped in rubbing alcohol can be used, followed by a touch-up with leather conditioner for added protection and shine.

Handmade in Tofino, BC

When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent Canadian designers from across the country like Julie Neufeld. Julie created her first leather bag in 2010, inspired by the blank canvas and innovative female artists before her, Julie creates covetable, highly functional leather bags. As a self taught designer, Julie has honed her craft, bringing her concepts to life with utmost quality in mind. With an extensive understanding of both the materials she works with and the wardrobes her bags are destined to join, each piece is thoughtfully considered and designed with you, and people like you in mind. Each bag is handmade with love in Tofino, British Columbia.

Leather Care:

For optimal care and maintenance of your bag, it's recommended to treat it with leather conditioner once a year. Not only does this hydrate the leather, but it also adds an extra layer of protection.

Daily wear may result in small scratches on your bag, which are simply a natural part of owning a leather accessory. Fortunately, many of these marks can be buffed out using a lightly damp cloth in a circular motion. Applying a bit of leather conditioner afterwards can help rejuvenate your bag.

In case of any spots or stains, a 1:1 mixture of saddle or Castile soap and warm water, along with a soft cloth, should do the trick for spot cleaning.

For more stubborn marks like ink stains, a cotton swab dipped in rubbing alcohol can be used, followed by a touch-up with leather conditioner for added protection and shine.

Handmade in Tofino, BC

Also available in Strawberry and Bright Blue

When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent Canadian designers from across the country like Julie Neufeld. Julie created her first leather bag in 2010, inspired by the blank canvas and innovative female artists before her, Julie creates covetable, highly functional leather bags. With an extensive understanding of both the materials she works with and the wardrobes her bags are destined to join, each piece is thoughtfully considered and designed with you, and people like you in mind. Eve Gravel's gorgeous in-house designed prints make this piece truly unique, adding a touch of originality to your look.

title: Meg Petite Chemise (Blue)
description:
The Petite Chemise Cropped Blouse by Meg is Effortlessly tailored and endlessly wearable. Designed with a short, boxy fit for a relaxed yet flattering silhouette, it’s the perfect piece to pair with your favourite denim or high-waisted trousers. A pointed collar and button-down front lend classic structure, while a single large patch pocket adds a touch of functional charm. Crafted from 100% cotton, it’s breathable, soft, and made for all-day comfort.

Sizing Notes: This style fits true to size and is a relaxed oversized cut. We recommend ordering your usual size. Please see size chart at the end of the photos for measurements. Still unsure? Send us an email!

Svenja is wearing XS/S

100% Cotton

Wash cold, Hang to dry

Made in New York City, USA

Also available in White

title: Naked & Famous Judy Shirt (Faded Blue Brushed Flannel)
description:
The Judy Shirt by Naked & Famous is an easy, lightweight take on the classic brushed flannel button-up. The Judy Shirt offers a relaxed, easy fit through the shoulders and body for comfort without being oversized. Finished with classic button-up detailing!

Sizing Notes: This top fits true to size, it is a classic boxy silhouette. We recommend ordering your usual size or size down for a closer fit. Unfortunately there is no size chart available for this item. If you need measurements send us an email!

Svenja is wearing M

100% Cotton

The Soft Brushed Faded Flannel is a 5.5oz Japanese cotton flannel woven from melange yarns, which are cross-dyed fibers that deliver depth and timeless heathered character, beloved in classic flannels.

After weaving, the fabric is brushed (or napped) to raise fine fibers, giving it a plush, cozy texture. The result is a soft, easy layer that feels worn in from day one, in the best way.

Wash cold with like colours, Hang to Dry

Made in Canada 

Also available in Black Lightweight Denim

When you shop at Victoire, you're supporting Canadian brands like Naked & Famous. Best known for their denim, Naked & Famous uses premium Japanese fabrics and all of their products are cut, sewn and made in Canada.

title: Korelli Aurora Reversible Dress (Dusty Rose)
description:
The Aurora Dress by Korelli is a reversible maxi dress-- a two for one dress! One side features a subtle bateau neckline, and the other, a more pronounced neckline for a bolder style. The draped short sleeves provide comfort and lightness. The "Goethe" side features a slightly flared cut, creating a fluid and feminine silhouette. Crafted from a smooth, lightweight, and wrinkle-resistant polyester satin fabric with a beautiful sheen, this versatile dress is ideal for a variety of occasions, combining elegance and practicality in one ingenious design.

Sizing Notes: This dress fits slightly on the larger size. We recommend trying one size down if you want a tighter fit. Please see size chart for fit guidance. Still unsure? Send us an email!

Svenja is 6'0" and is wearing M

100% Polyester 

Hand wash in cool water at 30 degrees, do not bleach, do not tumble dry
Iron Low if needed
Avoid Trichloroethylene Solvent

Made in Canada

Also available in Black, Chocolate, Wine and Forest

When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent Canadian designers from across the country like Silvia, the founder of Korelli Designs. Silvia is originally from Barcelona, where she completed a degree in Fashion Design before relocating to Canada. Silvia now lives in Montreal where At Korelli, they are committed to quality, durability, and craftsmanship. Korelli focuses on using quality natural fibers to ensure that each garment not only feels incredible but also stands the test of time. Each collection is created in collaboration with talented local artisans and supports the local economy.

title: Daldanea Tunde Hoop Earrings (Multiple Sizes)
description:
Daldanea's hoop earrings are a must have piece in your jewelry collection. These handmade hoops are lightweight and delicate and with the addition of tiny bits of colour, they can effortlessly compliment your everyday look!

14K Gold Filled Hoops
Japanese glass beads.

1.25" or 1.75" hoop diameter.

Made in Saskatchewan.

When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent Canadian designers like Molly Ocean Patterson who is a Saskatchewan born Métis artisan/craftswoman who has worked in the Film Industry for the past ten years, and traveled to quite a few countries all over for work. Recently, she moved back home with her wife and 'model in residence,' Sofía, to transition to quieter life of crafts, gardening, and family making (cats included). Her designs are influenced by different life experiences along her travels, and her interests in Folklore, Mythology and Pictorial Arts.

title: Daldanea Silvina Earrings
description:
Moody charcoal meets soft creaminess in this dainty and intense dangly pair. The honey gold line slithering about, breaks up the two different shades of charcoal. And the richer charcoal shade surrounds a creamy lake like a shore. Ethereal floral motifs and dots of gold add to the texture and the softening of the two main contrasting colours. This is an elegant piece that feels great to wear when you want to enhance your look with a slight shine.

 

2 cm wide by 7.5 cm long, 2.2 grams each side. Glass and gold dangle earrings.

Japanese Glass Beads, Golden Nylon Thread, and the hooks are hand forged 14 KT gold filled wire for sensitive ears.

Made in Saskatchewan

description:

When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent designers like Karen Vaquilar who established Mercy House in 2016 and named the brand after her mother, Mercy, as it was her mother who introduced her to fashion and the realm of all of its possibilities and then joined forces with Amy Robinson.  The vast majority of the fabrics used are made in Montréal. Mercy House is a love letter to culture, as its seasonal collections are influenced and take references from art, music, architecture and film. The “Mercy House Aesthetic” with its oversized silhouettes and futuristic ethos has been quoted as “Sci-Fi Hip Hop”. Mercy House’s goal and intention is to raise the vibration of the collective through its cultivation of uplifting messages, feelings of empowerment, connection, and love.

title: Valerie C. Oversized Shirt (Black)
description:
Valérie C.'s Oversized Shirt is a loose fitting button-up collared shirt constructed from 100% Tencel fabric. Featuring elastic cuffs to allow for easy rolling up and down of the sleeves. It's breathable, soft and a perfect addition to any capsule wardrobe! 

Sizing Notes: This shirt fits true to size and is meant to have a relaxed oversized fit. We recommend ordering your usual size. Please see size chart for measurements. Still unsure? Send us an email!

Svenja is wearing M, Valerie C. Model is wearing S

100% Tencel (OEKO-Tex Certified)

Tencel is breathable, durable and incredibly soft to the touch. 
Like Lyocell, it comes from the pulp of trees making it a natural fibre with a chemical transformation. It does not require pesticides or insecticides to grow and it washes easily in cold water. The TENCEL™ brand manufacturing process is powered by 100% renewable energy and uses significantly less water!

Hand wash with like colors. Do not tumble dry. Hang to dry. 
Iron at low temperature if needed. Do not use bleach.
Can be dry cleaned.

Made in Quebec

When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent Canadian designers like Valerie Canuel the designer and founder of Valerie C. Designs. Valerie has spent more than 10 years in the fashion industry between Montreal, Quebec and Paris, France; and is a graduate of Fashion Design and Marketing. Valerie's brand is a showcase of her values and passion for slow fashion with an emphasis on a contribution to build a more informed and transparent fashion industry.

title: Rightful Owner Shawl Blouse (Charcoal Merino Wool)
description:
Rightful Owner's Shawl Blouse is flirty meets comfy. This season the Shawl Blouse is made from a beautiful draped merino wool jersey. This is a modern take on wrapping yourself in a shawl.  Pair it with a skirt and heels for a great going-out look. An easy elevated basic, inspired by the awe and grandeur of cathedrals-- Borromini's specifically, a glory!-- built during the Victorian era.

Sizing Notes: This shirt is fitted with stretch. We recommend your usual size. Please see size chart at the end of the photos for measurements. Still unsure? Send us an email!

title: Naked & Famous Judy Shirt (Black Lightweight Denim)
description:
The Judy Shirt by Naked & Famous is an easy, lightweight take on the classic denim button-up done in a black lightweight Japanese denim. It features a 2x1 weave with a black warp and white weft. This fabric delivers the natural character of faded black denim without sanding or chemical treatments. The Judy Shirt offers a relaxed, easy fit through the shoulders and body for comfort without being oversized. Finished with classic button-up detailing!

title: Naked & Famous Super Girl Jeans (Stretch Selvedge Raw)
description:
The Super Girl Jeans by Naked & Famous are a 12.5oz Japanese Selvedge denim. They are a medium rise with a tapered leg and straight outseam that emphasizes the shape of your leg without being tight. Your perfect everyday jeans!

Sizing Notes: These pants fit true to size. We recommend ordering your usual size. Please see size chart at the end of the photos for garment measurements. Still unsure about size? Send us an email! 

98% Cotton, 2% Elastane (12.5oz Japanese Selvedge Denim)

The Stretch Selvedge is one of the most popular core selvedge fabrics in Naked & Famous Denim's lineup. Woven on vintage shuttle looms in a right hand twill construction, this 12.5oz Japanese selvedge denim combines the comfort of stretch denim with the beauty and fading potential of raw denim. The 2% elastane eliminates the break-in period and gives you a continual level of comfort that you can't experience in 100% cotton jeans. Other details include contrast stitching, full grain English tan leather patch, red selvedge ID, silver metallic buttons and rivets. Super Girl is an everyday denim essential.

Wash cold, inside outer, and separate from other items for the first few washes to avoid dye transfer. Hang to dry, do not machine dry.

Made in Canada

title: Market Canvas Molly Crossbody Bag (Kale)
description:
Introducing The Molly Crossbody Bag.  Vibrant, stylish, and always keeping you organized. Molly is the ultimate multitasker, easily transitioning from a crossbody to a shoulder bag and featuring 4 card slots, a phone pocket, and space for all your daily must-haves. Crafted from luxurious pebbled leather, Molly is the perfect companion for any occasion - day or night!

Dimensions: 10" W x 6" H x 2" D

Locally soured 100% premium top grain leather with brass hardware

Unlined, and Plastic Free.

Leather Care:

For optimal care and maintenance of your bag, it's recommended to treat it with leather conditioner once a year. Not only does this hydrate the leather, but it also adds an extra layer of protection.

Daily wear may result in small scratches on your bag, which are simply a natural part of owning a leather accessory. Fortunately, many of these marks can be buffed out using a lightly damp cloth in a circular motion. Applying a bit of leather conditioner afterwards can help rejuvenate your bag.

In case of any spots or stains, a 1:1 mixture of saddle or Castile soap and warm water, along with a soft cloth, should do the trick for spot cleaning.

For more stubborn marks like ink stains, a cotton swab dipped in rubbing alcohol can be used, followed by a touch-up with leather conditioner for added protection and shine.

Handmade in Tofino, BC

When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent Canadian designers from across the country like Julie Neufeld. Julie created her first leather bag in 2010, inspired by the blank canvas and innovative female artists before her, Julie creates covetable, highly functional leather bags. As a self taught designer, Julie has honed her craft, bringing her concepts to life with utmost quality in mind. With an extensive understanding of both the materials she works with and the wardrobes her bags are destined to join, each piece is thoughtfully considered and designed with you, and people like you in mind. Each bag is handmade with love in Tofino, British Columbia.
